gate_1_cross_model_primary_sign_reversal.criterion: At least two models have a style whose cluster-bootstrap CI shows delta F-score > 0 and delta voxel IoU < 0.

gate_2_stable_model_rank_reversal.criterion: A model pair has significant opposite orderings under F-score and voxel IoU for at least one style.

gate_3_medium_metric_family_by_style_eff.criterion: The same style has Cohen dz >= 0.5 for delta F-score minus delta voxel IoU in at least two models, with adequate photo baselines.

gate_4_seed_direction_consistency.criterion: Each stochastic model preserves the sign pair of mean delta F-score and delta voxel IoU in at least 80% of styles.

decision_rule: Expand only when at least two of the four frozen gates pass.
